title: config.toml
description: Configuration for Lux, located at the path reported by `lx config`.

server.description:
The LuaRocks repository server to fetch rocks and rockspecs from.
Default: "https://luarocks.org/".

extra_wally_registries.description:
Additional wally package registries (git-index URLs), in addition to the
official wally index.

namespace.description: The LuaRocks server namespace to use.

lua_version.description: The Lua version to use. Default: the detected installed Lua version.

user_tree.description: The tree in which to install rocks.

workspace_tree.description:
The tree to use when in a workspace.
Default: a ".lux" directory in the workspace root.

lua_dir.description: The directory in which to install Lua if it is not found.

cache_dir.description: The cache directory, e.g. for LuaRocks manifests.

data_dir.description: The data directory, in which the default user install tree resides.

vendor_dir.description:
A directory with locally vendored sources and rockspecs, used instead of
a remote server.

enable_development_packages.description: Whether to fetch development/scm rocks. Default: `false`.

verbose.description: Whether to display verbose output of executed commands. Default: `false`.

no_progress.description: Whether to disable progress bars and spinners. Default: `false`.

no_prompt.description: Whether to skip prompts, selecting the default option. Default: `false`.

timeout.description:
Timeout for network operations, in seconds. `0` disables the timeout.
Default: `30`.

max_jobs.description:
Maximum number of parallel jobs, e.g. for downloads and installs.
`0` means no limit.

variables.description:
Variable names mapped to their values. Lux substitutes these in the
`lux.toml` and in rockspecs before building.

access_tokens.description:
Access tokens for fetching sources from private hosts, mapped by host.
These can also be set via the `LUX_ACCESS_TOKENS` environment variable.

user_agent.description:
The user agent to use when making web requests.
Default: "lux/<version>" (CLI), "lux-lua/<version>" (lux-lua) or "lux-lib/<version>".

generate_luarc.description: Whether to generate a ".luarc.json" on build. Default: `true`.

luarc_file_name.description: The Lua language server configuration file name. Default: ".luarc.json".

wrap_bin_scripts.description:
Whether to wrap installed Lua bin scripts to run with the detected or
configured Lua installation. Default: `true`.

package_types.description: Which package types to include in searches.

no_tfa.description:
Whether to disable prompts for two-factor authentication (2FA) codes.
Default: `false`.

ExternalDependencySearchConfig.description:
Used as a fallback when searching for external dependencies if they
cannot be found using pkg-config.

prefixes.description:
Known installation prefixes for specific dependencies.
These can also be set via environment variables.

profile.description:
The build profile to use when compiling packages.
Default: [`BuildProfile::Release`]

runner.description:
Command prefix with which to wrap all build commands.

If set, every command spawned by the build backends is invoked as
`runner + [command, arguments...]`.

If unset, no wrapping is performed.

Profile.description: The build profile to use when compiling packages.
